verdict.rationale: Trivy is an open-source scanner that users install and run on their own infrastructure. It is distributed through common channels such as `brew install trivy` and `docker run aquasec/trivy`, and community users report running it in their own CI and bundled inside the self-hosted Harbor registry. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the open-source license, and docs on self-hosted server/client deployment or offline vulnerability-DB hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Trivy is available in most common distribution channels. ... `brew install trivy` ... `docker run aquasec/trivy`
After evaluating several leading options for open source vulnerability scanning, Trivy really stood out
It comes bundled with the harbor docker registry, meaning you get security analysis of your images
